video_title: “I'm Going To Take Advantage Of The Matchups.” | Jaden Mcdaniels Postgame Sound | 10.14.26

quotes.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels on the Timberwolves' strategy to combat physical defense
quotes.excerpt: We just got to screen better and then do the same thing they do to us

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: They were real physical with you guys. I think a couple of opponents are going to try to do that to you. What's the key to combating physicality?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
text_blocks.text: We just got to screen better and then do the same thing they do to us, like picking up full, being physical. I feel like we did it later in the game, but just screening for each other, getting each other open and just breaking the physicality.

quotes.social_post: Jaden McDaniels says the key to beating physical defenses is to match that intensity and screen better for each other. He says they have to do the same thing opponents do to them by picking up full court.

quotes.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels on the importance of freeing up Anthony Edwards
quotes.excerpt: When he's free and he's flowing down the court, he makes the right read every time

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: It's kind of saying that's really big for how you guys play, just to get him free so he can make those plays for you guys?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
text_blocks.text: Yeah, when he's free and he's flowing down the court, he makes the right read every time. He's like a weapon for us, so we always need him with the ball and be able to be comfortable with the ball.

quotes.social_post: Jaden McDaniels calls Anthony Edwards a weapon for the Timberwolves. He says when Edwards is free and flowing down the court he makes the right read every time and they always need him comfortable with the ball.

quotes.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels on maintaining ball movement without Anthony Edwards
quotes.excerpt: Just swinging the ball, trusting each other. We all know we can make plays in different ways

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: How do you keep the ball moving even when he's not out there?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
text_blocks.text: Just swinging the ball, trusting each other. We all know we can make plays in different ways. You're just figuring it out, and if they're over-pressing, you know, back door. You can throw the back door, come off, do some other stuff, but just sharing the ball and trusting each other.

quotes.social_post: How do the Timberwolves keep the ball moving without Anthony Edwards? Jaden McDaniels says it comes down to trusting each other and using back door cuts if the defense is over-pressing.

quotes.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels on exploiting smaller defenders in mismatches
quotes.excerpt: I know that the weaker defender be on me and I just take advantage when I get the ball

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: It seems like you're getting a lot of good matchups with who they're putting on you. Are you aware of that and trying to take advantage of that?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
text_blocks.text: Yeah, I'd be aware. It comes with the game. I don't really force nothing, but I know that the weaker defender be on me and I just take advantage when I get the ball.

quotes.social_post: Jaden McDaniels is aware when teams put weaker defenders on him. He says he does not force anything but he is ready to take advantage of those matchups whenever he gets the ball.

quotes.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels on the Timberwolves' offensive growth and punishing teams
quotes.excerpt: They can't put them on Anthony Edwards or Jaden McDaniels, so I mean, they can put them on me

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Earlier in your career, teams would sometimes try to do that and then you punished that. And now it just kind of seems like a product of how good you guys are starting five is, right?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
text_blocks.text: Yeah, for sure. They can't put them on Anthony Edwards or Jaden McDaniels, so I mean, they can put them on me. I'm okay. I'm going to take advantage of it every time.

quotes.social_post: Jaden McDaniels on teams trying to hide defenders on him: I am okay with that. I am going to take advantage of it every time.

quotes.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels on his comfort level with his offensive role
quotes.excerpt: As long as I touch the ball, I'm cool. I'm not really stressed about nothing

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: The way things have gotten this far, are you comfortable with how much of a role you have in the offense?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
text_blocks.text: Yeah, I'm always comfortable. We're sharing the ball. As long as I touch the ball, I'm cool. I'm not really stressed about nothing. I'm just trying to win and play the right way.

quotes.social_post: Jaden McDaniels says he is comfortable with his offensive role as long as he touches the ball. He says he is not stressed about anything and is just trying to win and play the right way.

quotes.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels on maintaining ball movement when the offense gets stagnant
quotes.excerpt: Just passing and trying to play in the next action fast, that's going to go slip a screen

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: When the ball kind of gets sticky, how do you make sure that it is still swinging out to you or moving?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
text_blocks.text: Just passing and trying to play in the next action fast, that's going to go slip a screen or something, just to create some type of movement with the ball or without it.

quotes.social_post: When the offense gets stagnant Jaden McDaniels says the focus is on playing in the next action fast by slipping screens to create movement with or without the ball.

quotes.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels on his relationship with Dante
quotes.excerpt: Dante's my guy. We just can't wait to have him back and we just be messing around

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Dante has talked about how he's trying to be in here for guys to communicate with. What has your conversations with him kind of just meant to you?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
text_blocks.text: It means a lot. There are a bunch of unserious conversations, but Dante's my guy. We just can't wait to have him back and we just be messing around with each other. It ain't no serious stuff when we talk.

quotes.social_post: Jaden McDaniels says his conversations with Dante are mostly unserious. He says they are just messing around and cannot wait to have him back.

quotes.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels on the transition from rebounding to the fast break
quotes.excerpt: Knowing that we got to play fast and like I said, we got a bunch of versatile guys

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: You had a couple of rebounds tonight where you just grabbed it and started the break right away. Is that an extra incentive of, hey, if I get the board, I'm just going in this new offense?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
text_blocks.text: Yeah, and then just making the right play out of it, just knowing that we got to play fast and like I said, we got a bunch of versatile guys. So it don't matter who I pass it to, I know they're able to dribble, shoot and score.

quotes.social_post: Jaden McDaniels says the Timberwolves are prioritizing playing fast off rebounds. He notes that because the team is so versatile it does not matter who he passes to because everyone can dribble, shoot, and score.
